brief:
Spanish technology expert Enrique Arias Gil alleged that the United States and Israel orchestrated a surge of migrants into the Spanish city of Ceuta as retaliation for Madrid's support of Palestinian causes, Shehab Wire reported. Gil framed the migrant influx as part of a broader pressure campaign against Spain over its pro-Palestinian diplomatic positions.

The allegation surfaced as Spain has shifted its stance on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict in recent months. Gil's assertion connects the migration crisis at Ceuta, a Spanish autonomous city on the North African coast, to geopolitical tensions stemming from Spain's Palestinian advocacy. The claim underscores broader regional disputes over migration flows and international relations in the Mediterranean.
title: Spanish expert blames US and Israel for migrant crisis in Ceuta
